run_async_training_simulator: run one epoch of asynchronous FL training simulation using AsyncTrainingSimulator with an event generator and job scheduler
create_job_queue_stats: create a JobQueueStats instance to track pending jobs and compute event-based average queue length
start_training_on_device: start training on an AsyncClientDevice by calling start_training and scheduling it in the priority queue
end_training_on_device: end training on an AsyncClientDevice by calling end_training and updating job queue statistics
print_simulator_stats: print the current simulator stats including average pending jobs and current simulation time
